new_points.title: Photos reveal unexpected details from the world's first atomic test
new_points.content: Previously classified photos and documents show the scientific work that went into the world's first atomic test in 1945 – a test that, just weeks later, would see nuclear bombs dropped in Japan

new_points.title: Long Island Rail Workers Strike in First Walkout Since 1994
new_points.content: The Long Island Rail Road, the nation’s busiest commuter line, will suspend service for the first time in more than 30 years after labor groups and transit officials failed to reach a deal on wage increases by a Friday night deadline.
